subject: Shiny, two process the same time.

messages.author: d6f9c6ff776783d5
messages.subject: Shiny, two process the same time.
parts:
Hi, 

I have a process that take a few minutes, so when open two client and send request to do two of those process, the server response is the same result of two client, somebody know if I need to use a shiny-server to control this problem ?

Thanks.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny, two process the same time.
parts:
The two clients shouldn't receive the same result, unless you are doing something weird with global state. However, it would still be desirable to have two processes because the R process can only do work for one client at a time. The ability to have multiple processes per app will be a feature of the upcoming commercial version of Shiny Server. It is not available in the Open Source version.

Thanks!
